title: No Wind Resistance!
lyrics:
[00:06.30](Eternal Bushido)
[00:13.57]I don't know how it ends, I can't see it in the distance
[00:20.01]But, can you ever reach the end of a timeless existence?
[00:26.84]I'll bet ya I can run faster with no wind resistance
[00:34.40]I'll fly under no conditions
[00:41.28]Teach myself complete submission
[00:46.82]While I grant myself complete permission
[00:54.53]Just imagine being human, hating your confusion
[00:58.28]Denying 'til it's proven, laughing at illusion
[01:02.22]Thinking institution's the solution
[01:04.99]While tyranny and irony float in its pollution
[01:08.46]Imagine reducing yourself to your name
[01:10.35]Janet, you've got no one else you can blame
[01:11.96]You've stuck all your conscience inside of your brain
[01:13.67]So, now you just shoot stuff inside of your veins
[01:15.32]So, go ahead and find your meaning with your methamphetamine
[01:18.75]And once you can see that you've trapped all your grace
[01:20.69]Maybe you'll join me and, girl, we can race
[01:22.11]I'll bet ya, I can run faster with no wind resistance
[01:29.23]I'll fly under no conditions
[01:36.13]Teach myself complete submission
[01:41.68]While I grant myself complete permission
[01:57.12]No streets, receipts
[02:00.56]Off-beat heartbeat
[02:08.20]Just window seats
[02:10.84]For free, for free
[02:16.98]I've been here 60 years, and I'm still not bored
[02:20.50]There's absolutely nothing that I can't afford
[02:23.70]And I've found that almost everything is made of cardboard
[02:27.12]And there's absolutely nothing I can't sing with weird chords, and
[02:30.96]I can run faster with no wind resistance
[02:37.84]I'll fly under no conditions
[02:44.70]Teach myself complete submission
[02:50.24]While I grant myself complete permission
